answer: Make governance weight follow externally verified revenue after refunds, with no bonus for opening an account. Customer payment receipts have unique serials, and every resale or subcontract inherits rather than duplicates the original weight. A basalt quarry selling ferrous ore across an ocean earns influence from outside demand. A chain of aliases reselling the same order divides one receipt, so adding identities cannot manufacture extra voting power. The tradeoff is favoring larger sellers.
